gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-preahvihear: Heavy beads on a rod: Impact Label keeps every letter standing alone, with a high-set x-height. But Preahvihear keeps its letter mouths open, a modern foil to the heavy heading.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-radio-canada: Blunt and beaded: Impact Label stands each heavy letter alone. Radio Canada runs beneath it in sans-serif at a constant line weight, tall c, s and z, every curve left open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-roboto: Heavy and commanding: Impact Label spaces every letter apart like beads, pincer-ended c's included. Roboto then carries paragraphs smoothly, its round letters generously open and its capitals close to body height.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-anek-telugu: Wobbly bowls nearly sealed shut: that's Jelly Crazies. Anek Telugu, plain sans with wide, tall bowls left unlatched, gives that closed-up play a loose, open counterpart on the line.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-duru-sans: Jelly Crazies wobbles along at a leisurely walk, its bowls nearly sealed. Duru Sans, with wide openings on small letters, lets text move briskly, bodies filling the line while ascenders hardly show.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-golos-text: Nearly sealed bowls and a wobble define Jelly Crazies. Golos Text, sans-serif with an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s, opens what the heading keeps shut.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-inter-tight: Wobbly, rounded and nearly shut: that is Jelly Crazies. Inter Tight, sans-serif with short ascenders and curve tails held back, reads like bent tubing running quietly across a page.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-mr: Slow, wobbly, nearly sealed: Jelly Crazies ambles along with heavy bowls. Noto Sans Mro, sans-serif with large entrances into each letter, makes words look dense and tall through the middle as you read.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-th: Wobbly, slow, bowls nearly sealed: that is Jelly Crazies. What stands out most is the open-versus-closed push with Noto Sans Thai, plain sans with a lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-sans-ti: Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps its rounded letters open and inviting. Beside Jelly Crazies, whose monoweight wobble nearly seals every bowl, those lowercase shapes fill the line like inflated forms.
